mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, group_id AS groupId, user_name AS userName, user_random AS userRandom, user_end_time AS userEndTime FROM mac_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_name = #{userName} AND user_status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT group_id AS id, group_name AS name, group_status AS status, group_type AS typeIds, group_popedom AS popedomJson FROM mac_group WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
